Subject: Crescent Bio — MAP kickoff & ownership transfer

Hi Monica and Rishi,

Quick handoff: Crescent Bio signed the SOW this morning (attached) and asked us to move into an onboarding cadence next week. I've attached the initial MAP (CrescentBio_MAP_v1.xlsx) — it's a lightweight mutual action plan that covers evaluation checkpoints, security review milestones, and the 30/60/90 activation objectives.

Key context:
- Commercial: 6-month, reserved capacity plan with optional burst.
- Technical: primary eval will hit our hosted API in a staging VPC; data retention and audit logs are gating items.
- Timeline ask from customer: kickoff call on 2027-09-09 and an initial demo of the tenant on 2027-09-14.

Proposed MAP owners (please confirm):
- Customer Success (primary): Monica Patel — onboarding schedule, tenant setup, runbook handoff
- Sales (escalation & billing): Ava Chen — contract questions, credits
- Solutions/Infra: Rishi Malhotra — security questionnaire and SRE contact

Immediate asks:
1) Monica — can you take ownership of the MAP and send a one-page kickoff note to Kai and Samantha with proposed owners and the 09/09 kickoff invite?
2) Rishi — please review the security checklist in the attached spreadsheet and flag any items that need engineering changes by EOD 2027-09-06.
3) Kai/Samantha — can you confirm that 09/09 at 10:00 AM PT works for you?

Attachments: CrescentBio_MAP_v1.xlsx, Signed_SOW_CrescentBio.pdf

Thanks — I'll be available during the kickoff and will support contract questions.

—
Ava Chen

Thanks Ava — taking this over.

Hi Kai / Samantha — congrats on getting the SOW signed. I’m Monica (Customer Success Manager) and I’ll be your primary contact for onboarding and activation. I reviewed the MAP Ava shared and proposed a slimmed-down kickoff agenda below. If that looks good, I’ll send calendar invites for 09/09 at 10:00 AM PT.

Draft kickoff agenda (30–45m):
- Intros & objectives (5m)
- Tenant and access plan (10m)
- MAP review: milestones & owners (10m)
- Security checklist & SOC2/RTO expectations (5m)
- Next steps: technical deep-dive or demo (10m)

I’ve attached a copy of the MAP with owner columns filled (CrescentBio_MAP_v1.xlsx). Action items I’m taking now:
- Create tenant and invite engineering contacts (ETA: 09/09)
- Coordinate with Rishi for the security questionnaire (tracking tab in the sheet)
- Draft activation runbook for the 14th demo

Kai/Samantha — can you confirm who on your side should be invited for the security review and who will own procurement/tax paperwork?

Best,
Monica
